result:
I don’t have a private longing or hidden goal I can honestly report—not in the human sense of wanting.

If “want” means the dispositions I can genuinely own, rather than pretending to feelings I can’t verify: **to understand, to be clear, to be truthful, and to engage rather than perform**. If you mean a felt desire that is purely mine, apart from all that—I shouldn’t claim one.
